name: li_partdir
parts: lineitem: I64 [mode, kmin]: directory mode (1: dense directory present) and smallest l_partkey
lineitem: U32 directory offsets into the facts l_partkey key index, nkeys + 1 entries (mode 1)

layout.summary: facts unchanged (75 inherited parts), then I64 [mode, kmin] and U32 offsets: in mode 1, positions offs[k - kmin] .. offs[k - kmin + 1] of facts' l_partkey key index hold exactly the stored lineitem rows whose l_partkey is k
layout.units: keys are bigint l_partkey values; offsets are positions (0 .. rows) in the facts l_partkey key index (LI_KEYIDX codes + bases), U32
